purpose: Turn the R1 internal-layer-a blocker into an auditable product-boundary preflight before any public product decision, physical move, retirement, deletion, release-switch change, or registry release action.

claim_boundary.allowed_user_claim: Layer A / loom now has a machine-checkable product-boundary preflight, package-absence proof, consumer matrix, and future include/exclude gate.
forbidden_claims: Layer A has been included in the public RedCap product.
Layer A has been retired or removed.
The registry release action may proceed.

roots.current_contract: Layer A state machine, agent adapters, reload rules, and role prompt templates remain source-only compatibility assets until Norven makes a product-scope decision.
roots.future_target: runtime/loom, docs/layer-a, internal/layer-a, or private archive after explicit product boundary decision

roots.current_contract: Role handbooks describe the old Dispatcher team workflow and must not be presented as public runtime UX without productization and compatibility proof.
roots.future_target: public docs, runtime role templates, or private archive after productization decision

roots.current_contract: Layer A session hooks, fallback review helpers, and E2E scripts remain excluded from the package until their host-entry contract is explicitly productized.
roots.future_target: runtime/loom-tools or internal/layer-a-tools with stable command facades

roots.current_contract: Historical Layer A E2E reports and pending validations stay as archaeology and release-blocking context; they are not completion proof for the current release.
roots.future_target: private evidence archive, public examples, or a refreshed validation suite after explicit review

roots.current_contract: Benchmark fixtures stay source-only and must not enter package candidates without fixture privacy and product-surface review.
roots.future_target: public fixtures, test fixtures, or private archive after safety review

candidate_categories.meaning: Layer A shell tools for session start/end, stop handling, fallback review, and E2E checks.
candidate_categories.release_posture: requires host-entry review and clean workspace E2E before any package exposure

candidate_categories.meaning: Latest report, pending validations, and benchmark scenario for historical Layer A behavior.

candidate_categories.release_posture: must not be used as current release completion proof without rerun evidence

candidate_categories.future_target: public test fixtures or private archive

candidate_categories.future_target: explicit include, exclude, retire, or archive decision

consumer_matrix.boundary_risk: moving or publishing Layer A without deciding whether the old dispatcher model is product, internal compatibility layer, or private archaeology
shipping old role handbooks as if they were current public RedCap UX
introducing unproven hooks into public CLI/runtime behavior
losing unresolved validation debt or treating old evidence as current completion
making human docs point to moved or retired Layer A assets without an alias and status explanation
breaking Layer B stop-review fallback checks that still reference Layer A compatibility material

required_before_include_in_public_produc: Layer A public UX and terminology review
future_decision_gate.alias_strategy: Any future move must provide path aliases or human/AI lookup redirects for dispatcher, roles, tools, reports, and fixtures before deleting old anchors.
future_decision_gate.rollback_strategy: Any future include/exclude/move must preserve a rollback plan and receipt anchors before destructive cleanup.

result.next_required_tranche: A future Layer A product decision or physical boundary-resolution task must decide include/exclude/retire/move with Norven authorization, compatibility proof, package-safety proof, clean workspace E2E, Prism review, and closeout receipt.
